description_en: Modify event information in Event Center
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore modify-event-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --event-id 5422964 --event-action archive --action-params '{"recoverTime":"2023-04-17T14:02:35Z","recoverMode":"timePoint"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyEventInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the event. You can specify up to 20 event IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas
parameters.help_zh: 事件ID。如需查询多个，使用英文逗号分隔，最多支持20个
parameters.name: event_id

parameters.help_en:
The action to perform on the event. Valid values:

archive: Archives the event.

undo: Cancels processing for the event
parameters.help_zh:
事件处理动作，取值说明：
archive：归档
undo：不处理
parameters.name: event_action

parameters.help_en:
The parameters for the action, in JSON format. For example: `{"recoverMode": "xxx", "recoverTime": "xxx"}`.

recoverMode: The recovery mode. Valid values:

timePoint: Executes the task at the time specified by `recoverTime`.

immediate: Executes the task immediately.

maintainTime: Executes the task during the maintenance window.

recoverTime: The time to execute the task. This parameter is required when recoverMode is set to timePoint. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
动作相关的参数，Json格式。
当TaskAction取值modifySwitchTime时，本参数ActionParams取值为 `{"recoverMode": "xxx", "recoverTime": "xxx"}`。
recoverMode表示任务恢复模式，取值为：
imePoint：按照指定时间点执行。
immediate: 立即执行。
maintainTime：按照运维时间执行。

recoverTime表示指定的时间点，UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ，当recoverMode为timePoint时，该参数必填
parameters.name: action_params
